sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM results r JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND r.fastestLapTime <> ''
